{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check how many such patients there are
n_control_moderate = len(control_moderate)

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = control_moderate['responded'].mean()

print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE patients: {n_control_moderate}")
print(f"Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
